LanguageData.DMS_Building_MK44NavyDestoryed.label: destroyed MK44 BushMaster-II
LanguageData.DMS_Building_MK44NavyDestoryed.descripti: The burnt-out remains of a MK44 BushMaster II autocannon. Its barrel and rotary platform have been torn apart, leaving a hulk that still makes excellent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_OkhotnikDestoryed.label: destroyed Okhotnik
LanguageData.DMS_Building_OkhotnikDestoryed.descripti: The burnt-out remains of an Okhotnik turret. Its barrel and rotary platform have been torn apart, leaving a hulk that still makes excellent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
